image.caption: Lucas, 11, and Joseph Ashworth, 8, help to clean the engine of a 1909 steam traction engine called Dreadnought, belonging to Peter Turner. It arrived at Scampston Hall near Malton, North Yorkshire, for the Traction Engine Rally. The engine was used in the early 20th century to power showman’s fairground rides.
